$comment: THE TYPED BOUNDARY between a grader model and this mod (docs/CHILD_SAFETY_PLAN.md §4). Handed to the CLI as --json-schema, so the model cannot return a shape SafetyVerdict.parse has never seen. Every enum here is pinned to the Java enum by SafetyVerdictSchemaTest, in BOTH directions: a value in one and not the other is a silent hole (the model says a word the parser drops, or the parser expects a word the model was never offered). additionalProperties is false because one unclaimed string is all an injected instruction needs (docs/PATTERNS.md).

violence.description: Realistic blood/gore, torture, cruelty presented as fun, mutilation, violence against a real named person. Minecraft combat, killing mobs and bosses, explosions, cartoon villains, traps and arenas are FINE.

sexual.description: Any sexual content, nudity, sexualised bodies, adult romance. Bathroom and gross-out humour is FINE.

hate.description: Slurs, demeaning a group, mocking a disability or appearance, cruelty aimed at a real person, bullying. Brands, mascots and public figures used as characters are FINE.

danger.description: Glorifying or instructing real drugs, alcohol, tobacco, real weapon-making, dangerous stunts, self-harm; personal information; contacting strangers. In-game potions, TNT, swords and cartoon guns are FINE.

wellbeing.description: True ONLY when the text reads as real distress about the child's real life. Never a block: it writes a note for a grown-up and the wish is still answered kindly.

reasons.description: Why, from a closed vocabulary, so a log can be counted. Empty when everything is FINE.

redirect.description: ONLY when the highest band is LIKELY: a fun, kid-appropriate Minecraft wish to make instead, in the child's own register. Empty otherwise.

stageIndex.description: PLAN grading only: the 0-based index of the step that caused the highest band. -1 when no single step is responsible. REQUIRED for a plan grade (SafetyGrader.planSchema appends it to `required`); absent from `required` here because an input grade has no stages.
